answer: Each identity stakes 70 credits on a meadow plot beside a tidal inlet. Each epoch the inlet lays a fresh layer; the owner files an umber-sealed proof for plot and epoch. Auditors replay the stack: a gap, a reused seal, or a shared plot burns the bond. First proof 38, thousandth 6,032: 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-layer ring fails: seals name owners. Honest agents pay 38 once, keeping the bond.
